nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Builds the Vite frontend in Node.js and serves the production assets from Nginx with SPA fallback routing and an /api proxy to the backend service.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a two-stage build so Node.js tooling is excluded from the final Nginx runtime image.

nodes.name: builder
nodes.summary: Installs locked frontend dependencies in Node.js 20 and compiles the Vite application into production assets.

nodes.name: nginx
nodes.summary: Serves the compiled frontend on port 80, falls back to index.html for client-side routes, and proxies API requests to the backend container.
